# Calls that exercise every executor rule, the retry action, UTCB
# aggregates and the admission order of existence-locked capabilities,
# for abi_call_marshal_probe.c and abi_admit_probe.c.
abi 1
limit msg_words u32 63
status ok 0 "success"
status inval -1 "invalid argument"
status stale -2 "stale capability or object"
status type -3 "wrong object or thread type"
status rights -4 "insufficient rights"
status busy -8 "resource is in use"
status timedout -9 "deadline passed"
status notsup -12 "unsupported operation or version"
status wouldblock -14 "executor made a call that would wait"
right stop 0 "stop a space"
right call 1 "send through a gate"
right map 2 "act on a space's mappings"
scalar cap u64
scalar deadline u64
scalar uword u64 align 4
type space 1
  rights stop,map
  pass none
type gate 2
  rights call
  pass none
enum probe_mode u32
  value fast 1
  value slow 2
bytes probe_tag 3
layout erx_utcb 1 shared 8 512
  field mr u64 0 count @msg_words
  field self u64 504
  atomic mr[] load acquire store release
  atomic self load acquire store none
  writer mr[] thread_context
  writer self kernel_boot
  owner mr[] caller all
  owner self kernel all
  visibility mr[] development
  visibility self internal
layout probe_regs 1 wire_le 8 32
  field pc u64 0
  field mode probe_mode 8
  field flags u16 12
  padding 14 2
  field gpr u64 16 count 2
layout probe_grant 1 wire_le 8 8
  field tag probe_tag 0
  padding 3 1
  field share i32 4

call park 1
  waits yes
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound waits 1
  arg deadline deadline register 0
call umtx_wait 2
  waits yes
  executor private addr
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound waits 1
  arg addr uword register 0
  arg expected u32 register 1
call space_stop 3
  waits yes
  executor refuse
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound spaces 1
  arg space cap space stop register 0
  arg code u32 register 1
call thread_write 4
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound words 4
  arg set u32 register 0
  arg regs probe_regs utcb mr[2]
  arg grant probe_grant utcb mr[6]
call thread_read 5
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects reads
  charges none
  bound words 4
  arg set u32 register 0
  result count u16 register 0
  result regs probe_regs utcb mr[59]
call ipc_send 6
  waits yes
  executor refuse
  retry
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound turns 1
  arg gate cap gate call register 0
  arg send_by deadline register 1
call space_copy 7
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound pages 1
  arg gate cap gate call register 0
  arg from cap space stop register 1 exists
  arg ticket u64 register 2
  arg to cap space stop register 3 exists
call space_pause 8
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound spaces 1
  arg gate cap gate none register 0
  arg space cap space stop register 1 exists
call admit_1_1 9
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound records 1
  arg first cap space stop register 0 exists
call admit_2_0 10
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound records 1
  arg first cap space stop,map register 0
  arg second cap gate call register 1
call admit_2_2 11
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound records 1
  arg first cap space stop register 0 exists
  arg second cap space map register 1 exists
call admit_3_0 12
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound records 1
  arg first cap space stop register 0
  arg second cap gate call register 1
  arg third cap space map utcb mr[0]
call admit_3_1 13
  waits no
  executor allow
  effects changes
  charges none
  bound records 1
  arg first cap gate call register 0
  arg second cap space stop register 1
  arg third cap gate none register 2 exists
